name: Responsive Navigation Bar
description: Sticky top navigation header with keyboard-accessible mobile menu drawer, Escape-to-close behavior, and clean semantic landmarks.

preview.caption: Interactive live preview — click the mobile menu toggle or tab through links.

install: Copy navbar.html, navbar.css, and navbar.js into your project and include the script with defer.
usage: Place <header class="otter-nav"> at the top of <body>. Toggle aria-current="page" on the active navigation link.

verification.label: Browser E2E & Sandbox Verified
verification.details: Verified in headless Chromium E2E (tests/library-e2e.test.mjs): renders cleanly with zero console errors inside opaque-origin CSP sandbox; semantic <header>/<nav>, aria-expanded, and Escape dismissal reviewed.
